name: Democratic Kampuchea

localNames.name: កម្ពុជាប្រជាធិបតេយ្យ

flag.description: A red field with a yellow three-towered outline of Angkor Wat in the centre.
flag.symbolism: Red stood for the revolution; Angkor Wat, the national symbol of Cambodia, has appeared in some form on almost every Cambodian national flag.

hook: The Khmer Rouge state showed a yellow Angkor Wat outline on plain red; Cambodia today has a white Angkor Wat on a red band between two blue ones.
trivia: Under Khmer Rouge rule from 1975 to 1979, an estimated 1.5 to 2 million people died from execution, forced labour, starvation and disease.
Vietnamese forces took Phnom Penh in January 1979, ending the regime, but its representatives kept Cambodia's seat at the United Nations through the 1980s.
